mapper.insert: INSERT INTO person_edge (workspace_id, source_person_id, target_person_id, type, strength, note) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{sourcePersonId}, #{targetPersonId}, #{type}, #{strength}, #{note}) AS ne ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE type = ne.type, strength = ne.strength, note = ne.note

INSERT INTO person_edge (workspace_id, source_person_id, target_person_id, type, strength, note) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{sourcePersonId}, #{targetPersonId}, #{type}, #{strength}, #{note}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS id, IF(e.source_person_id = #{personId}, e.target_person_id, e.source_person_id) AS person_id, op.name AS person_name, op.company_id AS company_id, c.name AS company_name, e.type AS type, e.strength AS strength, e.note AS note FROM person_edge e JOIN person op ON op.id = IF(e.source_person_id = #{personId}, e.target_person_id, e.source_person_id) LEFT JOIN company c ON c.id = op.company_id WHERE e.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND (e.source_person_id = #{personId} OR e.target_person_id = #{personId}) ORDER BY e.strength DESC, op.name
